text:
Sarah M.: Quick sync on the Polarfield case study — interview finished this morning. Need a quick approvals flow so we can publish the story and tie it to the webinar on Friday. Draft quote is below, and I've attached the working doc (link up next).

Sarah M.: Draft quote: "With Redwood, Polarfield reduced inference latency by up to 30% while cutting per-token cost by ~40% on steady-state workloads." — please check wording.

Mark L.: This looks great. Suggest we hedge the latency claim a bit: change "reduced inference latency by up to 30%" -> "achieved up to 30% reduction in inference latency" to avoid sounding like a guarantee. Also small grammar tweak in para 2.

Priya S.: Heads up — Polarfield is fine with the logo but wants customer name used only in the blog and webinar, not in paid ads. I'll confirm their exact do-not-contact list. I can route inbound leads from the launch to our AE queue (HubSpot) — want a dedicated campaign tag?

Ana G.: Can legal review by EOD tomorrow? Two things we need: 1) signed media release (we got verbal, but need signed) 2) source for the 40% cost number (internal benchmark or dashboard export). Also remove wording like "guaranteed" if present. I can redline the quote once you update phrasing.

Sarah M.: Uploaded files here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PolarfieldDraft (docs: draft post, media release, benchmark export). Updated quote per Mark's suggestion.

Tom R.: For the webinar: propose format 20min product demo + 10min customer segment + 15min live Q&A. Can Polarfield do a 5–7 min customer segment? If yes, I'll get slide template started. Deadline for slides: Thursday 12pm PT.

Priya S.: Yes they can do 5–7 mins. I'll also ask for a 2-line bio for the rep. For the campaign tag use: Polarfield-Launch-2025. I'll create the HubSpot campaign and share the routing SOP.

Sarah M.: Final signoff checklist (please react when done):
```
- [ ] Final quote phrasing approved by product
- [ ] Legal review + signed media release
- [ ] Benchmark source uploaded
- [ ] Slides submitted (Thu 12pm PT)
- [ ] Webinar reg page live
- [ ] HubSpot campaign + inbound routing set
```

Ana G.: I'll review the doc tonight and post redlines in the Drive doc by tomorrow morning. Once the release is signed (scanned into Drive) legal can mark approved.

Mark L.: Fixed grammar and updated quote text in the doc. Left a comment about the benchmark methodology — Sarah please confirm the sample set (p99 or average?).

Sarah M.: Confirmed it's steady-state 95th percentile; added a note in the benchmark export.

Tom R.: Starting the slide deck now. Using the short customer segment slot as a place for a live demo screenshot + quote slide. Will ping when template is ready. :computer:

Priya S.: HubSpot campaign created and AE queue mapping set. I'll add campaign members after registration page goes live. :white_check_mark:

publish-bot: Scheduled announcement draft posted to /#marketing-drafts for review.

Sarah M.: Huge thanks. I'll update here when Ana posts legal OK. Target publish + webinar: Friday. :tada:
